observation: 71 four intended frames and three front frames inspected. Saddlecloth now drapes against back with narrow binding; no rigid board visible in these views. Sash remains coherent front/rear evidence70, minor shoulder curl. Whole face remains synthetic: long uniform exposed fibers, thin wedge moustache, soft flat skin and comb-like brow. Horse still lacks living coat/face richness. Retain71 drape, use final72 for integrated facial hair/root and surface scale proof; no whole production readiness.
comparison: Actual353 negative and accepted production quality; local technical success is not whole-form qualification.
